1479-5700-5701-8337-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-8337-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and M'Ress trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1981-2415-6273-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6273-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4279-6255-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6255-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2869-2921-3184--173.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature that costs {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning that creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

851-4365-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-4365-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

250-779-1479-5414-7892.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-7892.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5414-7892.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

uses.n: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant

2615-5008.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a higher life total than Tree of Perdition's toughness.
2615-5008.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
2615-5008.notes: If the opponent's life total was at least double Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved, they will lose the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

1548-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1548-7334.description:
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Port Razer and causing it to enter tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-1242-7503.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Elegant Entourage triggers, giving Cinderhaze Wretch +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Cinderhaze Wretch ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-2511-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

2557-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

618-4089--112.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glasspool Mimic that has haste. Choose to have Glasspool Mimic enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Glasspool Mimic token instead.
618-4089--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Glasspool Mimic's toughness.

176-413-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-413-6705.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

480-5686-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

3564-4275-5231-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4275-5231-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Repeat.
3564-4275-5231-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

1492-2866-4779-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4779-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

92-1738-5306.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Serra Avatar's toughness.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

586-997-3375-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1453-1497-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1453-1497-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

305-1029-5028.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Llanowar Tribe.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
305-1029-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

804-3546-3783-4249-4300.description:
Activate Nykthos's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Nykthos from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Sakashima the Impostor and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor and Minn triggers, putting Nykthos and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-3821-6060.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}
1170-3821-6060.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}
Cast Forced Worship by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Forced Worship spell.
Activate Forced Worship by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1792-2585-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1792-2585-5864.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Retraction Helix.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

2092-2757-5685.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying at most {1}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2947-4050-4881.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vesperlark, adding one mana of any color.
When Vesperlark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Activated Sleeper, adding one mana of any color.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Vesperlark.
Repeat from step 3.

3658-4468.description:
Mystic Decree causes all creatures to lose flying.
Form of the Dragon prevents non-flying creatures from attacking you, and since none of your opponent' creatures can have flying, no creatures can attack you.

914-4013-4659.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionsit enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two Treasure tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
